Annotation Interface Meta

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) @Repeatable(MetaEntries.class) public @interface Meta
An entry of the _meta of an MCP tool, prompt, resource or resource template, declared on the annotated method. It is ignored unless the method is also annotated with Tool, Prompt, Resource or ResourceTemplate. 
@Tool
@Meta(key = "com.example/category", value = "weather")
String weather(String city) { ... }
Since:
2.2.0

  • Element Details

    • key

      String key
      Returns:
      A non-empty key following the MCP metadata key grammar. A key may have a reverse DNS prefix followed by /, as in com.example/category. MCP reserves prefixes whose second label is modelcontextprotocol or mcp. Repeating the same key and value on a method produces one entry. A malformed key or conflicting values for one key cause startup to fail.

    • value

      String value
      Returns:
      The value, which is always a string: the _meta entry cannot be a number, a boolean or an object. For those, define the primitive with a factory and set its _meta there.
